## Change

Move the complete original Git subtree `347b848c78278c44622795e1a137987c2ca766aa` beneath `artifacts/checkpoints/pr-evidence-archive-163/relocated-originals/`. All **188 original files / 26,428,588 bytes**, modes, blobs, nested trees, raw logs, manifests and checksums are preserved. Add five provenance, path mapping and scoped review files. - Independent source/path audit and exact 188-file mapping are included. The final remote-tree review independently fetched and recomputed the actual Git trees and confirmed all 188 originals, 187 untouched siblings and five metadata blobs. Review SHA-256: `669b351c1bf8a70bacb0b3a5a6af523112d98a27f91a8b39148e6ebf919bf292`. Actual PR CI/P7 checks are still required before normal merge.
